worldcombat.skill.crunch.summary: Lunge in and bite down, then grind: after the bite a short grind deals a second hit and may lower the target's Defence while leaving a guardbroken gap. Its fangs use a lower defence coefficient, so it chews through high-defence targets - heavier and slower than Bite, but a reliable way to open a guard.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.description.0: The bite deals %1$s contact damage, and its fangs use a lower defence coefficient than usual, so it bites harder into high-defence targets.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.description.1: It pounces up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block fang radius.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.description.2: After latching on it grinds for %1$s, then settles a second grinding hit of %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.description.3: When the grind ends it has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Defence by %2$s stage and leave a guardbroken identity for %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.crush.on: Crushing style: grinds longer, tears the guard down more often and leaves the gap longer, at the cost of a lighter bite and a slower wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.crush.off: Snapping style: faster to cast and a heavier single bite, but a shorter grind and a lower chance to crush the guard.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite rises to %2$s and the crush chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.use.0: Bite down and grind a guard to pieces
worldcombat.skill.crunch.use.1: Leave a guardbroken gap for the next move
worldcombat.skill.crunch.use.2: Chew through a high-defence target with armour-piercing fangs
worldcombat.skill.crunch.preference.crus: On: grinds longer, tears the guard down more often and leaves the gap longer, but hits slightly lighter and winds up and cools down slower. Off: a quick snap - faster and heavier, but less likely to crush the guard.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.preference.ai.m: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger chases harder and more easily ends up beside the target after a whiff.
worldcombat.skill.crunch.preference.ai.o: On: prefer targets that do not yet carry the guardbroken identity, saving the gap for later moves. Off: sort Crunch as an ordinary melee heavy bite.
